title: TW3 Drive - The Everything Game (Teaser)
author: Less-Negotiation1022
selftext: Created a game revolving around my area in London in Unreal Engine using GPT-6 Astra. Called it "TW3 Drive: The Everything Game" because it has all aspects of gaming that I enjoy. Driving, violence, missions, an exceptional story, individual playable sports where you get in-game money if you win, a virtual arcade where you can win money too and all of this can improve your character's quality of life. Still building it out fully, the characters need a lot of work but I really couldn't contain my excitement lol.
